subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should maintainers close this protected PR as superseded by current main's official Anthropic Vertex SDK 0.19.0 upgrade, or keep it open as a deliberate local auth-client replacement direction?
rationale: The central dependency chain is now fixed on current main, but the PR is protected and the remaining local auth-provider replacement is a product/owner decision automation cannot make.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Close this PR after confirming the current-main SDK 0.19.0 path satisfies the audit/auth issue and track any release/backport separately.

options.title: Sponsor A Fresh Narrow Repair

options.title: Keep Local Client Direction

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
